body.summary: A streaming adaptation of Isaac Asimov's Foundation stories, centred on mathematician Hari Seldon's prediction that the Galactic Empire will collapse and his plan to shorten the coming dark age by founding a Foundation of scholars at the edge of the galaxy. The series splits its time between the Foundation's early survival struggles and the Empire's ruling dynasty of cloned emperors, whose decline mirrors the predicted fall. ||The first season ends with the Foundation settling on Terminus and the Empire's genetic dynasty facing a succession crisis after one Brother Day is replaced.||

arcs.summary: Hari Seldon's psychohistory predicts imperial collapse; he is tried and exiled, and the Foundation is founded at Terminus.
The cloned emperors confront signs of decline and a succession crisis within their own dynasty.
Salvor Hardin defends the Terminus colony against external threats and internal doubt.
